title: Bioseed 6527 cotton: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Bioseed 6527 cotton: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Bioseed 6527 cotton is a cotton variety. About 116 days to harvest, 2.4 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: Bioseed 6527 is a registered cotton variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2003 as NSIC 2003 Ct 13. Cotton Development Administration bred it. It takes about 116 days from sowing to harvest, with 2.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Bioseed 6527 cotton takes about 116 days from sowing to harvest. That is 3.5 days faster than the average of the 7 cotton varieties with a day count, 119.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 2.44 t/ha beats the average of its group, 2.15. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: The pests and diseases that hit cotton fields most often: [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Bioseed 6527 cotton
Cotton needs a long dry spell at boll opening. Pick a variety by lint yield and fiber quality. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 116 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 2.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Bioseed 6527?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
